manifest.claim: target-domain-free transfer of the completion module: trained and selected on KITTI-360 alone, evaluated on untouched SemanticKITTI and Occ3D without adaptation. NOT whole-system zero-shot: the frozen foundation models (LingBot-Map, MoGe-2, Trident-H) have not had their training provenance audited, and LingBot-Map's published mixture includes KITTI-360.

training_data.occupancy_supervision: rebuilt from raw Velodyne sweeps t..t+20 with ground-truth poses; endpoints occupied, interiors free, unobserved and cross-sweep-conflicting voxels unknown and excluded from the loss
training_data.semantic_supervision: frozen Trident-H fused over t+1..t+20, kept only where geometrically supported and where both halves of the future window agree; soft probabilities preserved
